verdict.rationale: n8n's AI agent nodes (LangChain integration, connecting to OpenAI/Anthropic/Google) let users build workflows that generate AI insights from data, and n8n explicitly markets use cases like 'Sales can generate customer insights from reviews' and 'Sec Ops can enrich security incident tickets' (n8n-docs-27, n8n-docs-25). However, this insight-generation is something the user must construct via workflow-building rather than a built-in analytics/insights feature that surfaces automatically inside the product. Missing for 10: evidence of an out-of-the-box, no-build insights/suggestions panel or dashboard analyzing user data automatically, and independent hands-on confirmation of this specific insight-generation use case working well.
